groups.title: Difficulty & Wild Dinos
groups.hint: Wild creature levels, how many there are, and loot.

groups.title: Tamed Dinos
groups.hint: What your tames can do, and their limits.

groups.title: Breeding
groups.hint: Lower interval = more often; higher speed = faster.

groups.title: Players & Survival
groups.hint: The players' side of the island.

groups.title: PvE / PvP & Combat
groups.hint: Who can fight whom, and the damage rules.

groups.title: Structures & Building
groups.hint: Limits, decay and pick-up rules for bases.

groups.title: World & Time
groups.hint: The clock, saves and idle players.

groups.title: Chat & HUD
groups.hint: What players see, and the welcome message.

groups.title: Cross-ARK Transfers
groups.hint: Uploads and downloads between maps and servers.

groups.title: Stats Per Level
groups.hint: How much each level point adds, for players, wild dinos, tames and mutagens. 0 is read by the game as 1, so 0.01 is the lowest.

settings.label: Harvest Health
settings.help: How much damage trees and rocks take before they break.

settings.label: Item Stack Size
settings.help: How many of an item fit in one slot.

settings.label: Resource Respawn Period
settings.help: Lower makes resources grow back sooner.

settings.label: Optimised Harvest Health
settings.help: Helps when the Harvest Amount is very high.

settings.label: Difficulty
settings.help: 5 = wild dinos up to level 150 (official), 1 = up to level 30.

settings.label: Wild Dino Resistance
settings.help: Damage wild dinos take (higher = they take more).

settings.label: Wild Dino Torpor Drain
settings.help: How fast knocked-out wild dinos wake up.

settings.label: Force Wild Respawn Every (seconds)
settings.help: Wild dinos respawn on a restart after this many seconds. 0 turns it off.

settings.label: Auto-Destroy Decayed Dinos
settings.help: Claimable decayed tames are removed on load.

settings.label: Destroy Tames Above Level
settings.help: Tames above this level are deleted on start. Official servers use 450.

settings.label: Flyer Speed Leveling
settings.help: Lets players level movement speed on flyers.

settings.label: Flyers Carry Wild Dinos In PvE
Baby Cuddle Interval
settings.help: Lower is more cuddles (imprinting) in the same time.

settings.label: Unlimited Mindwipes
settings.help: Lets players use the Mindwipe Tonic an unlimited number of times (ARK's own description). It does not say that the 24 hour wait between uses goes away too, so players may still see that timer.

settings.label: No Diseases
settings.help: Disables Swamp Fever and the others.

settings.label: Offline Raid Protection
settings.help: A tribe's structures cannot be damaged while all its members are offline.

settings.label: Offline Protection Delay (seconds)
settings.help: How long after logging off the protection starts.

settings.label: No Structure Decay (PvE)
settings.help: Abandoned PvE structures are never auto-destroyed.

settings.label: Hide Damage Source In Tribe Logs
Automatic PvE Window
settings.help: Switches a PvP server to PvE on a daily timer.

settings.label: PvE Window Starts (seconds into the day)
PvE Window Ends (seconds into the day)
Old Structure Auto-Destroy Timer
settings.help: Needs the Auto-Destroy Old Structures launch option.

settings.label: Day Cycle Speed
settings.help: The whole day-night cycle. Above 1 is faster.

settings.label: Kick Idle Players After (seconds)
settings.help: Needs the Kick Idle Players launch option.

settings.label: Creative Mode Toggle
settings.help: Shows it in the pause menu.

settings.label: Single-Player Balance
settings.help: Extra balance multipliers meant for small servers.
